WE #xykwe0h: build outcomes were recorded `orphan-released` for every Claude and agy build.

Cause: a `claude --bg` handle is a session id (not a pid) and the claim owner pid is the short-lived dispatching process, so orphan-adopt read every Claude build as dead one tick later and released it. A paused await-verify session looked dead too. The pre-dispatch already-done check only looked at merged PRs by title.

Fix (minimal; kept off the tick-overrun #4356 and prep-concurrency changes to `build-dispatch-daemon.mjs`, which this PR does not touch):
- `scripts/conveyor/build-delivery-evidence.mjs`: real delivery = PR on `lane/<num>-` (open or merged) or resolved card.
- orphan-adopt: a dead claim with delivery evidence settles as `pr-opened` / `pr-merged` / `card-resolved`, never `orphan-released`; a live job record or live await-verify record keeps the claim alive.
- dispatch-lane: new `build-delivered` gate refuses a build whose PR is open/merged or card resolved (build kind only).
- Allowlisted the branch-prefix `--search` in the no-search-backed-pr-list guard (same pattern as run-rating).
- Coroner: its build metrics read tick rows, not outcomes, so no change; its repeat-card rate falls once relaunches stop.

Tests are red on old code (replays of #4388->#4339, #4382, #5189 await-verify). verify-lane green.
